request.name: Card Builder Desk
request.description: A reusable card inside any Phi site for designing and requesting new reusable WidgetPhi cards; let owner name the card, describe its behavior, choose existing enhancements or new builds, and send authenticated, source-linked build requests to the WidgetPhi robot workshop without requiring the customer to use GitHub. Ensure the public interface never gets repository tokens.

handoff.blue: Validate source, tenant data and reusable setting schema
handoff.green: Implement and integrate card logic in WidgetPhi before publishing

buildRequestEvidence: Request was validated; template changes are not production code.
